subject.title: feat(message): add universal pagination contract with cursor support for MSTeams

question: Should OpenClaw accept this private `_pagination` details key plus `MessageActionPagination` runner field as the shared message-action pagination contract after the security and sibling-compatibility blockers are fixed?
rationale: The code defects are concrete, but the permanent cross-provider cursor contract affects shared CLI, agent, plugin, and docs behavior and was left as a maintainer decision on the canonical issue.

options.title: Accept Repaired Shared Contract
options.body: Keep the shared contract direction, but require origin validation, sibling migration or fallback compatibility, and tests for every advertised cursor action before merge.

options.title: Split Provider Work
options.body: Close or pause this PR and track separate provider-specific pagination fixes until maintainers design the shared contract explicitly.

options.title: Limit To Teams Search
options.body: Narrow the PR to validated MSTeams search cursor support and leave `read`, `pins`, and cross-provider contract work on the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Accept Repaired Shared Contract
recommendation.body: Keep the shared contract direction, but require origin validation, sibling migration or fallback compatibility, and tests for every advertised cursor action before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person most clearly stated the remaining product boundary on the canonical pagination issue after the partial formatter fix merged.
